Vaccine heatmap

plot_vaccine_heatmap.Rd

One row per vaccine (licensed first, then the invented candidates), one column per serotype, plus a column with the IPD each vaccine leaves. Serotype columns: one block per licensed vaccine (its serotypes not in any earlier vaccine), then everything else.

Usage

plot_vaccine_heatmap(
  known_serotypes,
  known_ipd,
  vaccine_data,
  all_serotypes,
  n_exhaustive = 6,
  method_labels = character(0),
  ipd_scale = 1e+05,
  ipd_label = "IPD per\n100,000"
)

Arguments

known_serotypes

Named list of licensed vaccines (serotype vectors), in display order.

known_ipd

Named numeric vector: IPD score per licensed vaccine.

vaccine_data

Invented vaccines, e.g. from design_vaccines(): columns ipd, vaccine (string with "-" or "," separators), method.

all_serotypes

All serotypes in the model (e.g. samodel$st), so serotypes in no vaccine get a column too.

n_exhaustive

Number of exhaustive vaccines to show, lowest IPD first. All non-exhaustive vaccines are always shown.

method_labels

Named character vector: display name per method. Methods not listed keep their own name.

ipd_scale

IPD is multiplied by this for display.

ipd_label

Header of the IPD column. Keep in step with ipd_scale.

Value

A list with plot (the combined plot), width and height (suggested size in inches).
